journey.name: Wear - Post Actions
journey.description:
Verifies like, repost and bookmark on a post: each control shows its state, the counts follow, repost asks first, the state survives leaving and reopening the post, a slow action shows as pending and ignores a second tap, and the controls are not offered when the phone cannot run actions. Also covers "Open on phone".
Run on a round Wear OS emulator with the bench build. Start with the app stopped. The first post in the bench feed (Ana Ruiz) starts liked with 128 likes, not reposted and not bookmarked. The "slow_actions" scenario holds every action for 15 seconds.

actions.action: Launch Nubecita on the watch with the bench scenario "default"
Tap Home and then tap the first post, by Ana Ruiz
Verify that the post screen shows Ana Ruiz, how long ago it was posted, the full text "Golden hour from the pier tonight. Worth the cold hands." and its image
Verify that the clock at the top of the screen does not overlap the author line
Scroll down with the rotary crown until the Like, Repost and Bookmark controls are visible
Verify that the counts read 128 likes, that Like is on, and that Repost and Bookmark are off
Tap Like
Verify that Like is off and the counts read 127 likes
Tap Like
Verify that Like is on and the counts read 128 likes
Tap Bookmark
Verify that Bookmark is on
Tap Repost
Verify that a dialog asks "Repost this?" with a way to dismiss and a way to confirm
Swipe right from the left edge of the screen to dismiss the dialog
Verify that the post screen is shown, Repost is still off and the counts read 0 reposts
Tap Repost and confirm in the dialog
Verify that Repost is on and the counts read 1 repost
Swipe right from the left edge of the screen to go back
Verify that the feed is shown
Tap the first post, by Ana Ruiz, and scroll down to the controls
Verify that Like, Repost and Bookmark are all on
Tap Repost
Verify that Repost turns off without a dialog and the counts read 0 reposts
Tap Bookmark
Verify that Bookmark is off
Scroll down until the "Open on phone" button is fully visible and tap it
Verify that a confirmation that the post was sent to the phone is shown and then closes by itself, leaving the post screen
Launch Nubecita on the watch with the bench scenario "slow_actions"
Tap Home, tap the second post, by Ben Okafor, and scroll down to the controls
Tap Like
Verify that Like shows as on at once
Tap Like again within 5 seconds
Verify that Like is still on
Wait 15 seconds
Verify that Like is on and the counts read 43 likes
Launch Nubecita on the watch with the bench scenario "no_actions"
Tap Home, tap the first post, by Ana Ruiz, and scroll down to the end of the post
Verify that the counts and the "Open on phone" button are shown and that Like, Repost and Bookmark are not offered
